'''Niccolò Ammaniti''' ({{IPA|it|nikkoˈlɔ ammaˈniːti}}) is an Italian writer, winner of the [[Premio Strega]] in 2007 for ''[[As God Commands (novel)|As God Commands]]'' (also published under the title ''The Crossroads''). He became noted in 2001 with the publication of ''[[I'm Not Scared (novel)|I'm Not Scared]]'' (''Io non ho paura''),<ref name="smh">{{Cite web |url=http://www.smh.com.au/articles/2003/05/09/1052280430712.html |title=How to succeed without really failing |last=O'Grady |first=Desmond |date=10 May 2003 |website=[[The Sydney Morning Herald]] |access-date=10 January 2017}}</ref> a novel which was later made into a [[I'm Not Scared|movie]] directed by [[Gabriele Salvatores]].

==Biography==
Niccolò Ammaniti was born in Rome on 25 September 1966. He studied Biological Sciences at university, and though he did not complete his degree,<ref name=strega>{{cite web|title=Niccolò Ammaniti|url=http://www.strega.it/ammaniti.html|website=Strega.it|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080710081813/http://www.strega.it/ammaniti.html|archive-date=10 July 2008|language=it}}</ref> his first novel, ''Branchie'' (published by Ediesse in 1994, and then by Einaudi in 1997),<ref name=official>{{cite web|title=Biography|url=http://www.niccoloammaniti.it/index.php?page=biografia_eng|website=NiccoloAmmaniti.it|access-date=15 August 2015}}</ref> drew from his unfinished dissertation.<ref>{{in lang|it}} Niccolò Ammaniti, "Ai miei lettori", ''Branchie'', Torino, Giulio Einaudi editore, 1997.</ref><ref name="strega" /> In 1999, ''Branchie'' was adapted into a [[Branchie|movie with the same title]].<ref name="strega" /> In 1995, Ammaniti and his father Massimo published the essay ''Nel nome del figlio''.<ref name=official /> In 1996, he appeared with his sister in the low-budget movie ''[[Growing Artichokes in Mimongo]]''.<ref name="strega" />

A short novel written with Luisa Brancaccio for the anthology ''Gioventù Cannibale'' edited by [[Daniele Brolli]] came out in 1996,<ref name="strega" /> as did a collection of short stories, ''Fango''.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Fango / Niccolò Ammaniti |url=https://opac.sbn.it/risultati-ricerca-avanzata/-/opac-adv/detail/TO00360645? |access-date=6 April 2024 |website=OPAC SBN |language=it-IT}}</ref> ''Fango'' was shortlisted as a finalist work at the 1997 Premio Nazionale di Narrativa Bergamo.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Raccolta Premio Nazionale di Narrativa Bergamo |url=http://legacy.bibliotecamai.org/cataloghi_inventari/opere_stampa/raccolte_librarie/catalogo_premio_bergamo.html |access-date=6 April 2024 |website=Biblioteca Civica Angelo Mai |language=it |archive-date=7 May 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190507084007/http://legacy.bibliotecamai.org/cataloghi_inventari/opere_stampa/raccolte_librarie/catalogo_premio_bergamo.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> In 1999, Ammaniti published the novel ''Steal You Away'' (''Ti prendo e ti porto via''),<ref name="strega" /><ref name="official" /> followed by the 2001 ''[[I'm Not Scared (novel)|I'm Not Scared]]'' (''Io non ho paura''), which won the 2001 [[Viareggio Prize]] and was adapted into a [[I'm Not Scared|film]] directed by [[Gabriele Salvatores]] in 2003.<ref name="strega" /><ref name="official" />

In 2006, he published ''[[As God Commands (novel)|As God Commands]]'' (''Come Dio comanda''),<ref>{{Cite web |title=Come Dio comanda : romanzo / Niccolò Ammaniti|url=http://id.sbn.it/bid/LO11081909 |access-date=6 April 2024 |website=OPAC SBN |language=it-IT}}</ref> which won the [[Strega Prize]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=2007. Niccolò Ammaniti |url=https://premiostrega.it/PS/2007-niccolo-ammaniti/ |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210923064159/https://premiostrega.it/PS/2007-niccolo-ammaniti/ |archive-date=23 September 2021 |access-date=23 September 2021 |website=Strega Prize |language=it}}</ref> The novel was adapted into a [[As God Commands|movie]], once again directed by [[Gabriele Salvatores]].<ref name="Oblique" /> In 2009, he published ''Let the Games Begin'' (''Che la festa cominci''),<ref name="Oblique" /> and in 2010 ''[[Me and You (novel)|Me and You]]'' (''Io e te''), which was later adapted into a [[Me and You (film)|movie]] directed by [[Bernardo Bertolucci]].<ref name="Oblique" /> The script, co-written by Bertolucci, Ammaniti, and others, was nominated for Best Screenplay at the 2013 [[David di Donatello]] awards and at the 2013 [[Globo d'oro|Italian Golden Globe]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.repubblica.it/spettacoli/cinema/2013/06/14/news/david_donatello_2013-61115684/ |title=Sei David per Giuseppe Tornatoretrionfa ai David di Donatello 2013 |last=Fumarola |first=Silvia |date=15 June 2013 |website=[[la Repubblica]] |access-date=10 January 2017}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ilcinemaitaliano.com/nomination-globi-d-oro-2013/ |title=Globi d'Oro 2013: tutte le nomination |date=12 June 2013 |website=Il Cinema Italiano |language=It |access-date=10 January 2017}}</ref>

In 2015, he published the novel ''[[Anna (novel)|Anna]]'',<ref>{{Cite web |title=Anna / Niccolò Ammaniti |url=https://opac.sbn.it/risultati-ricerca-avanzata/-/opac-adv/detail/PAR1232683 |access-date=5 April 2024 |website=OPAC SBN |language=it-IT}}</ref> which six years later was adapted into a TV show aired on [[Sky Italia]] and directed by Ammaniti himself.<ref>{{Cite web |date=17 March 2021 |title='Anna', la serie di Niccolò Ammaniti su Sky dal 23 aprile: il TRAILER |url=https://tg24.sky.it/spettacolo/serie-tv/2021/03/17/ammaniti-anna-serie-tv-trailer- |access-date=5 April 2024 |website=Sky TG24 |language=it}}</ref> His directorial debut came in 2017 with the TV series ''The Miracle'', released one year later, a project he both created and co-directed alongside Francesco Munzi and Lucio Pellegrini.<ref>{{Cite web |last=D'Amico |first=Valentina |date=18 May 2017 |title=Sky Italia, Wildside e Niccolò Ammaniti per "The Miracle", serie tv sulle lacrime della Madonna |url=https://movieplayer.it/news/sky-italia-wildside-e-niccolo-ammaniti-per-the-miracle-serie-tv-sulle-_50834/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230930035059/https://movieplayer.it/news/sky-italia-wildside-e-niccolo-ammaniti-per-the-miracle-serie-tv-sulle-_50834/ |archive-date=30 September 2023 |access-date=7 April 2024 |website=Movieplayer.it |language=it}}</ref> In 2023, eight years since his last novel, he published ''[[La vita intima]]'', winning the [[Viareggio Prize]] again, 22 years after his initial recognition with ''I'm Not Scared''.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Paloscia |first=Fulvio |date=30 July 2023 |title=Niccolò Ammaniti vince il Premio Viareggio |url=https://firenze.repubblica.it/cronaca/2023/07/30/news/niccolo_ammaniti_vince_il_premio_viareggio_repaci_2023-409532729/ |access-date=7 April 2024 |website=la Repubblica |language=it}}</ref>
